caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a basket with a handle, rendered in various shades of red and brown. The basket has an oval opening at the top, with a thick, arched handle attached on either side. The body of the basket is decorated with a series of vertical, ribbed patterns that accentuate its bulging form. The base of the basket is rounded and also features a scalloped or fluted edge. The colors range from deep red to lighter, almost pinkish-red highlights, with areas of shading that give the object a three-dimensional appearance. The drawing is centered on an off-white, rectangle background with a slightly darker beige border, and the artist’s name "John Tarantino" is written in the lower right corner of the image. There are no other objects or elements in the composition.
title: Ornamental Small Basket
